test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Out of 500 students in a college, 350 play cricket, 125 play kabaddi, 75 neither play cricket nor kabaddi. Find the percentage of the number of the students who play both kabaddi and cricket.
solution:
Total students in college = 500

Number of students who play cricket = 350

Number of students who play kabaddi = 125

Number of students who neither play cricket nor kabaddi = 75

Number of students who either play cricket or kabaddi = (Total students in college - Number of students who neither play cricket nor kabaddi)

⇒ 500 - 75

⇒ 425

Number of students who play both cricket and kabaddi = (Number of students who play cricket + Number of students who play kabaddi) - Number of students who either play cricket or kabaddi 

⇒ 350 + 125 - 425

⇒ 50

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/605972e29ae209f34e3ffa759ab9e692082fa81161711fe75e762ab8899f90f7.png] 

**Percentage of the number of students who play both cricket and kabaddi = (Number of students who play both cricket and kabaddi / Total students in college) × 100**

⇒ {50 over 500} times 100

⇒ 10%

Therefore, **there are 10% of students who neither play both cricket and kabaddi.**

Hence, the correct answer is "10".
